seoTitle: Credit Card Payoff Calculator: Months and Interest
metaDescription: Find how many months a card takes to clear at a fixed payment and the total interest, or the payment needed for a target date. Free.
intro: Shows the time to clear a credit card balance and the interest it costs, or the monthly payment needed to finish by a date.
why:
Card interest compounds monthly, so paying only a little above the interest keeps you in debt for years. Seeing the months and the total interest at different payments makes the cost concrete.

Set the payment to 0 and give a target number of months to get the payment you need. Real cards compute interest daily and may change the rate, so use the result as an estimate.
howTo: Enter the balance and the APR.
Enter a fixed monthly payment, or 0 and a target number of months.
Read the months to zero and the total interest.
